# jQuery 4.0.0 Slim

Exact upstream factory module, initialized only in the browser. Slim omits Ajax/effects; GSAP controls animations.

Source: https://github.com/jquery/jquery-dist/blob/4.0.0/dist-module/jquery.factory.slim.module.js

Git blob SHA: de6a9f1071fae293f1b39422969733a34b4f467d

Original source/license notices are preserved in the module and `jquery-LICENSE.txt`. Next.js minifies the module in the production bundle. No runtime CDN or global `$` is added.
